question: Two careful engineers implementing this rule independently, with only this contract, would produce DIFFERENT behavior on some input (the rule is ambiguous, under-specified, or relies on unstated host facts).

rules.text: The result is the ascending list, without repeats, of every line number covered (R5) by any header (R3) in diff. Headers may arrive in any order and may overlap; the union is sorted numerically. No header -> the empty list. The function never throws on in-envelope text.

diff is cut into LINES at each LINE_BREAK character and only there; a line starts at offset 0 or right after a LINE FEED. CR, U+2028 LINE SEPARATOR, U+2029 PARAGRAPH SEPARATOR, U+0085 NEXT LINE and every other character are ordinary characters inside a line, so header-shaped text after any of them never starts a header. In a CR LF diff the CR stays at the end of the earlier line, after that line's header, where R3 ignores it. CITED ruling F1 (2026-11-02)

A header is a line that BEGINS with HEADER. Only that prefix must match: whatever follows the closing " @@" in the same line (git's function-context text, a CR, a third "@", further header-shaped text) is ignored and never yields a second header. Every line of the whole text is examined, not only lines between hunks.

Numbers are runs of the ten ASCII digits only; leading zeros are allowed and a run of any length is read as its exact decimal value. Let C be the new-side start and N the new-side count (TABLE COUNT). The old side "-a[,b]" must have the shape, but its values are never read or bounded. CITED ruling F6 (kept)

Let E = C + N - 1, the header's last line, in exact integer arithmetic on the values of R4. The header covers the lines L with max(C, 1) <= L <= the upper bound TABLE RANGE gives, or nothing when the table drops it. Hence N = 0 covers nothing; line 0 is never covered, and a start of 0 covers lines 1 through N - 1 (ruling N3, kept: git never writes it); line SAFE_LIMIT itself can be covered. CITED ruling F2 F3 N1 N2 (2026-11-02)

Any line that does not begin with HEADER contributes nothing; there is no partial or lenient reading. In particular each separator is exactly one ordinary space (a tab or a doubled space breaks the header); there is no sign; a comma must be followed by at least one digit (",": not a header, NOT the default count); a second ",digits" on either side breaks the header; "@@@" combined-diff headers are not headers. CITED ruling F4 (kept)
absent (the start digits are followed directly by " @@") -> 1
"," then digits with value d >= 1 (",3", ",0003")         -> d
E = SAFE_LIMIT + 1              -> SAFE_LIMIT (the range is CUT one line short, not dropped) CITED ruling N4 (kept, declared)
